name: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm
nameVi: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm – Hội An
summary: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm is the swiftlet nest, steamed when you buy it, and registered as a geographic indication on 23 November 2020. In May 2026 the grades yến quang, yến thiên, and yến bài were quoted from nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram, a product price rather than a bowl.
origin: Cham Islands. Nests from Hòn Lao, Hòn Tai, and Hòn Khô, in the trade of Tân Hiệp.
culture: The geographic indication Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm – Hội An was registered on 23 November 2020. Harvests run from mid-April to early May and from mid-August to early September, about four or five days each. The visitor sight for the trade is the nest-trade temple in Bai Huong, not the cliff.
howToEat: Steamed, if you are buying the product. The kilogram range is the product, not a snack price.
seoTitle: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm — registered swiftlet nests
seoDescription: Swiftlet nests from Tân Hiệp, registered 23 November 2020, steamed when you buy them. A 2026 kilogram range is the product, not a bowl.
